Although it doesn't specify in the card text, we always play so that
disciplines can only be played "on a ready vampire you control".
Otherwise, they could be played on uncontrolled vampires as well.

In "real" terms, a vampire does not go into torpor and wake up a
generation lower. You can't diablerise whilst you sleep!

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <3972f33d...@nntp.netcomuk.co.uk>, Stubby
<vt...@netcomuk.co.uk> writes

>can you play a master skill card on a vampire in torpor?

Yes. It's "play on a vampire" which means anything controlled, either
ready or not.

It doesn't allow you to play it on something contested or uncontrolled,
however. That requires specific card text.

--

James Coupe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Play on a <something-or-other> means a "controlled"
something-or-other by default. And vampires in torpor are controlled.
